questions.question: How does ReviewLab evaluate AI tools?
questions.answer: ReviewLab uses structured evaluation of features, usability, pricing, support, automation, accuracy and workflow suitability when evidence is available.

questions.question: Are ReviewLab rankings sponsored?
questions.answer: ReviewLab's stated methodology is designed around independent evaluation rather than paid placement.

questions.question: How often are reviews updated?
questions.answer: ReviewLab can record product updates, retesting and review-history changes in its structured data when verified information is available.

questions.question: How should I compare AI tools?
questions.answer: Compare workflow fit, output quality, pricing, support, integrations, audience fit and independently recorded review scores.
